fields.Name: IT120 - OpenAI Decisions API (GPT-6 Luna Decisions)
fields.Description: OpenAI's GPT-6 Luna Decisions model (gpt-6-luna on OpenAI's Decisions API, public beta) resolves from the synced metadata through AIDecisionRunner to the request each of its two routes would send, with no network. OD1 GPT-6 Luna Decisions is an Active Decision model at PowerRank 57, separate from the GPT-6 Luna LLM, with no effective Decision limits (OpenAI documents none); it has an OpenAI Model Developer row, an Active OpenAI Inference Provider row naming OpenAIDecision and gpt-6-luna with no input-token limit, and an Active OpenRouter Inference Provider row naming OpenRouterDecision and the pinned openai/gpt-6-luna-decisions-20261006 with 1,050,000 input tokens, the OpenAI row at the higher priority; each vendor has an active Realtime cost row at $0.10 per million input tokens with free output; the OpenAI vendor takes an API Key credential. OD2 the shipped OpenAIDecision is registered under 'OpenAIDecision', and ClassFactory.CreateInstance(BaseDecision, 'OpenAIDecision', credential) builds a subclass of it (the bundle's guard) that reads an API Key credential's endpoint and appends /decisions; the default endpoint is https://api.openai.com/v1/decisions. OD3 a real AIDecisionRunner.ExecuteDecision on the Default Decision prompt with override naming the model on OpenAI and a legacy key POSTs to https://api.openai.com/v1/decisions with the key as the bearer and the body {model: gpt-6-luna, input: the state, questions: [a predicate, a choice with choices [{value, description}], a score with levels [{label}]]} in question order, each named by its key; the answers, scripted in the shapes openai-node 7.30.0 types, come back mapped (the Choice renormalised from probabilities summing to 0.98, the Score keyed by level label, score 2.7 on levels valued 0 to 3) with the resolved model; and the MJ: AI Prompt Runs row is recorded against the model and OpenAI, successful, with 1,000 input tokens and a cost of $0.0001 from the OpenAI cost row, since OpenAI's response carries no cost. OD4 the same override on OpenRouter builds OpenRouterDecision, which POSTs the System One body with model openai/gpt-6-luna-decisions-20261006 to https://openrouter.ai/api/alpha/decisions with its key, maps the answers OpenRouter returned in a live call on October 7, 2026, and records the run against the model and OpenRouter with 406 input tokens and OpenRouter's reported cost of $0.0000406. OD5 with keys for both routes and the override on OpenAI, the candidates are the model on OpenAI then on OpenRouter; OpenAI declines the Choice question with a refusal answer, the attempt fails with "Question 'team': OpenAI declined to answer it (refusal)" and allows failover, and the run answers through the OpenRouter row, one request to each route. OD6 with no credential the model on OpenAI has none (asserted first); a real API Key credential created through CredentialEngine and bound to the model's OpenAI Inference Provider row (the model also has an Active Model Developer row on OpenAI) sends Authorization: Bearer <token>, not the credential's JSON, and the answers map. OD7 Default Decision's candidates keep their order with the model in the catalog: Jev on OpenRouter, then LLM Decision, then the power-matched fallbacks, the model's OpenAI and OpenRouter rows among them; with no OpenAI decision credential the runner selects the first of Jev and LLM Decision it has a credential for; with an API Key credential bound to the model's OpenAI row that row is a credentialed candidate still behind both and the selection does not change; and with every other decision driver made unavailable the run fails over past the credentialed candidates ahead of it, LLM Decision included, to the model on OpenAI (the decision drivers are the shared scripted stand-in for this check). OpenAIDecision and OpenRouterDecision are replaced for the whole bundle by subclasses that override only SendRequest, record each request and answer only while a check arms them, refusing with a 500 otherwise, so nothing reaches api.openai.com or openrouter.ai. Every prompt run, credential, binding and credential audit-log row the bundle creates is deleted. IT120 is a provisional number and may be renumbered at merge.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: GPT-6 Luna Decisions is usable as a Decision model: its metadata resolves with both routes, their drivers, API names and prices and no undocumented limits, the OpenAIDecision driver builds through the ClassFactory, and an AIDecisionRunner call naming it on OpenAI or OpenRouter sends that route's request, maps its answers and records the run against the model and vendor; a refusal from OpenAI fails over to OpenRouter, a bound credential sends its token, and Default Decision's selection is unchanged.
